verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents HIPAA (readiness, a unified control mapping, a breach notification template), GDPR (added through its multi-framework approach), and PCI DSS (compliance software, ASV scans, pentesting). HITRUST is covered as well. All of these run on one platform: unified controls and cross-framework mapping mean a new framework only adds the requirements not already met. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-framework use, and GDPR evidence beyond marketing pages (no help-center control mapping like HIPAA's).
